system.description: A thick, heavy tome bound in well-crafted iron and leather. A wide red ribbon flows out from the centre of the book, a gold ancestor badge at the end. The grudges within contain the history of a dwarf hold. Some have been carefully crossed out, though these are very few... Encumbrance: 4 Any Dwarf that reads from this Book of Grudges increases the {Df} bonus granted by their Grudge racial special ability by 1 until the end of the day.
